bb_reversion_daily.description: Close below lower BB(20,2) while above SMA200 -> buy; exit at the middle band

bb_squeeze.description: BB width at a 30-bar low, then a close outside the band; exit at mid band

connors_rsi2.description: Close > SMA200 and RSI(2) < 10 -> buy; exit close > SMA5 (hold 1-5 days)

crypto_supertrend.description: BTC/ETH long while 1h Supertrend 10/3 is up (checked in NSE hours only, USDT)

donchian_turtle.description: Close above prior 20-day high -> buy; exit below 10-day low; 2 ATR stop

ema_crossover.description: EMA 9/21 cross + RSI>50 + above VWAP (mirror for shorts), 1.5/3 ATR

ema_trend_swing.description: EMA20>EMA50 uptrend, close crosses back above EMA20 -> buy; 8% trailing stop

external_signals.description: Executes signals Claude writes using the TradingView MCP (claude/mcp_strategies)

gap_and_go.description: Gap >0.8% + first 15m candle confirms + break of its high/low, 2R

hourly_macd_swing.description: 1h MACD crosses above signal while above EMA200; exit on cross down; 2/4 ATR

macd_adx.description: MACD histogram crosses zero with ADX>20 and EMA50 trend; exit on opposite cross

momentum_rotation.description: Hold top-3 NIFTY 50 by 3M return (above SMA50, TV rating > 0); rotate out below top 10

nifty_buy_hold.description: Benchmark - 100% NIFTY 50 ETF (NIFTYBEES), buy once and hold

orb_breakout.description: 15-min opening range breakout, long/short, stop at other side, 2R target

rsi2_scalper.description: RSI(2)<10 above EMA50 (or >90 below), exit on snap-back or after 4 bars

supertrend_intraday.description: Supertrend 10/3 flips on 15m, stop at the Supertrend line, 2R

tv_rating_scalper.description: TradingView 15m STRONG BUY/SELL + 1h agreement; exit when 15m turns neutral

tv_rating_swing.description: NIFTY 50 names rated STRONG BUY (1D) + BUY (1W) by TradingView; 7% trailing stop

vwap_pullback.description: Trend (EMA20>EMA50) + pullback that holds VWAP, 1 ATR stop, 2R target

vwap_reversion.description: Fade 2-sigma stretches from VWAP, exit back at VWAP
